## 6b · What I told or made for the user
Key recommendations and specifics the user may revisit:

**Instagram hashtags recommended** (with approximate post counts given at time):
- Handmade jewelry: #handmadejewelry, #handmadeshop, #handcraftedjewelry, #jewelrymaking, #handmadewithlove
- Unique accessories: #uniqueaccessories, #accessorize, #jewelrylover, #fashionaccessories, #statementaccessories
- Indie fashion: #indiefashion, #alternativefashion, #bohofashion, #indiestyle, #fashionrebel
- Tip: use 5–10 niche-specific hashtags per post

**Facebook ad advice**: refine targeting using interest/behavior data from the 50 clickers; optimize ad creative and landing page; consider Lookalike Audiences, Custom Audiences, and retargeting

**Bible-based guides**: provided structured guides on creativity, productivity, self-esteem, and understanding God's will — each with 5 methods, corresponding Bible verses, and free resource suggestions (apps like YouVersion, Trello, Headspace, etc.)

**Moab travel**:
- Must-sees: Arches NP, Canyonlands NP (Island in the Sky), Dead Horse Point SP
- Beginner off-road trails: Hell's Revenge (beginner route), Fins and Things, Kane Creek Canyon Road
- Bike rentals: Poison Spider Bicycles, Chili Pepper Bike Shop, Moab Cyclery
- Beginner bike trails: Bar M, Klonzo "Easy Does It", Moab Brands
- White Rim Road: 100-mile dirt road, needs high-clearance 4x4, permit required (at visitor center or online), backcountry permit for overnight; typical 2–3 day itinerary
- Best times: spring (Mar–May) and fall (Sep–Nov)
- Events: Easter Jeep Safari, Moab Music Festival (Sep), Moab Folk Festival (Nov)
- Day trips: Canyonlands Island in the Sky (1h15m), Dead Horse Point SP (30m), Hovenweep (2h), Natural Bridges (2.5h)

**Canyonlands Island in the Sky**: scenic drive 12mi paved; hikes — Mesa Arch Trail (1mi RT), Grand View Point Trail (2mi RT), Upheaval Dome Trail (1.7mi RT), White Rim Overlook Trail (2mi RT)

**Aspen / Rocky Mountains**:
- Trail: Maroon Bells Scenic Trail — 10mi out-and-back, ~1,500ft elevation gain, moderate-to-challenging; best late Jun–early Oct; reserve shuttle bus (8:30am–5pm, limited parking)
- Breakfast spots: Aspen Coffee Company, Peach's Corner Cafe, Spring Cafe, The Coffee Lab
- Casual lunch: CP Burger, Meat & Cheese, Aspen Brewing Company, Aspen Kitchen
- Shopping streets: Galena St (luxury), Cooper Ave (local/market), Mill St (galleries), Hyman Ave (upscale + Explore Booksellers)
- Art: Aspen Art Museum, Baldwin Gallery, Galerie Maximillian
- Scenic drives: Independence Pass (32mi), Castle Creek Road (13mi), Smuggler Mountain Road (4mi)

**Hiking boots**: recommended Merrell Moab 2 Mid Waterproof for user's 10-day NZ trek — Vibram TC5+ outsole, good ankle support, waterproof membrane, good on rocky/uneven terrain; advised break-in beforehand

**Stove**: recommended MSR PocketRocket 2 (compact, windscreen, boils water in 3.5min), Jetboil Flash, Snow Peak LiteMax; also MSR Titan Pot / Snow Peak Titanium Pot

**Water filter**: recommended Sawyer Mini Water Filter — 2 oz, 0.1 micron absolute filter, 100K gallon lifespan; user chose this over purification tablets because "I'll be trekking for 10 days and don't want to carry a lot of tablets" [user said]; advised regular backwashing

**No-bake energy bites recipe**: 2 cups rolled oats, ½ cup creamy almond butter, ¼ cup honey, pinch of salt; optional add-ins (chocolate chips, nuts, seeds, dried fruit, coconut); refrigerate 30min, form 1-inch balls, yields 12–15 bites; store in fridge up to 1 week or freeze up to 2 months

**Smoothie — Banana-Avocado Boost with Spinach**: 1 ripe banana, ½ avocado, ½ cup frozen pineapple, ½ cup unsweetened almond milk, 1 tbsp honey, ½ tsp vanilla extract, 1 cup fresh spinach, ice as needed

**Other smoothie recipes given**: Berry Bliss, Mango-Peach Delight, Green Goddess

**Healthy snack list**: fresh fruits, nuts/seeds, energy balls, yogurt+granola, veggie sticks+hummus, protein bars, hard-boiled eggs, apple+PB, edamame, dark chocolate

**Healthy desserts list**: fruit parfait, dark-chocolate-dipped fruit, chia seed pudding, banana "nice" cream, avocado chocolate mousse, oatmeal raisin cookies, baked apples, Greek yogurt berry cups, homemade granola bars
